support_claim: The billing record names Vellum Print Co Ltd as billed_name, and SOW-VEL-2022 lists Vellum Print Co Ltd as Counterparty, but no observation links the billing referent to the contract counterparty as the same legal entity.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence, not name compatibility alone; the packet provides only matching names across billing and contract sources without an identity link. DISTINCT requires evidence of distinctness, which the packet does not contain. With neither burden met, UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
